headline: Votes on a disability retirement application, nine new members, and seven superannuation requests.
summary: The proposed 2027 budget, a PRIM wire, and a November warrant are also on the agenda. A refund request and a transfer request also go to a vote.
items: Involuntary disability retirement application, in executive session
PRIM wire for November 2026, plus October 2026 PRIM statement and performance summary
Treasurer's reconciliation for August, September, and October 2026 retiree account
Trial balance and cash books for September 2026
Performance review and salary for administrative assistant
Refund or rollover request from Annie Liacos
Transfer requests from Cody Marshall and Hannah Parkes
PERAC memo #27/2026 on free cybersecurity training
Deaths of Catherine R. Eastman, Marguerite H. Fears, and Virginia M. McVey
location: 127 EASTERN AVENUE or VIA REMOTE PARTICIPATION
